tools.name: check_token_safety
tools.description: Before buying a token on Base, check it: simulates a real buy and sell (honeypot and hidden-tax test), reads owner powers (mint, blacklist, fee changes, pause), whale concentration, liquidity lock and scam lists. Returns a verdict (scam / high_risk / caution / low_risk) with plain-language reasons.

tools.name: check_address_safety
tools.description: Before sending crypto on Base, check the destination: scam blacklists, address poisoning (a look-alike of an address you really use; pass `from` = your wallet), token contracts and burn addresses where funds are lost, never-used addresses. Returns a verdict with reasons. 5 free checks per day, then

tools.name: recent_liquidity_collapses
tools.description: New Base tokens whose pool liquidity collapsed (fell 90%+ from its peak: a rug pull or a heavy dump) in the last hours, newest first, with peak and remaining liquidity, hours from launch and the creator wallet. Use it to exit positions and blocklist serial creators. 5 free calls per day, then $0.002

tools.name: check_token_creator
tools.description: Before buying a newly launched Base token, check the wallet that deployed it: how many of its earlier tokens Rug Watch followed, and how many collapsed (rug pull or dump). Verdict: serial_collapser / collapsed_before / no_collapses_seen / unknown. 5 free calls per day, then $0.002 per call via x402
